steps.subject: sky
steps.action: start the light area with a little titanium white
steps.motion: drop in color and let it go
steps.rule: we need a light source in the painting

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: criss-cross x strokes outward from the light area
steps.load: more white for a brighter area
steps.rule: clean the brush each time so dirty color stays out of the light

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: very light cross strokes for light in the back

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: indications of little trees with the one inch brush
steps.rule: just indications since the front covers it

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: touch in yellow ochre with a little thalo blue
steps.rule: a different shade of green

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: highlight with indian yellow and cadmium yellow dabs

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: darker indications on the far sides
steps.rule: less color as it moves away from the light source

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: knife indications of tree trunks in brown and white
steps.rule: this is background so it can stay loose

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: soft bushes with the big brush in layered greens and browns
steps.rule: the brown dulls the mix

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: small bush with the corner of the big brush
steps.motion: let them play back and forth

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: darker green and yellow bushes on the far side
steps.rule: kept darker because it is far from the light

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: permanent red, small quantity

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: pull titanium white straight down for water
steps.load: white over the greens and yellows

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: keep the reflection strokes straight down
steps.rule: an angled stroke will not look like a reflection

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: lightly go straight across the water

steps.subject: land
steps.action: cadmium yellow peninsula down to the water

steps.subject: land
steps.action: dirt areas following the lay of the land
steps.rule: water lies in the low ground not on top of the hill

steps.subject: land
steps.action: highlight the dirt with yellow ochre and white

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: add grass with the big brush after thinning
steps.rule: makes the area look more real

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: cut thin water lines with the knife
steps.rule: thin paint slides off the knife for clean lines

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: dead tree in van dyke brown
steps.rule: dead trees are easy to see against the black

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: knife highlight on one edge of the dead tree
steps.rule: helps it stand out and gives it form

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: bluish hint on the other side of the dead tree
steps.rule: reflected light gives it character

steps.subject: other: moss
steps.action: hang thin moss with the fan brush and paint thinner

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: big bush in the foreground with the big brush

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: big tree with branches sticking out on one side
steps.rule: closes up that side and helps the composition

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: little weeds with the liner in thin brown

steps.subject: other: moss
steps.action: hanging moss lines on the back trees
steps.rule: keeps the back trees from looking bare

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: highlight the bushes with cadmium yellow, sap green, indian yellow and yellow ochre
steps.rule: layering one bush at a time creates depth

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: highlights on the top limb with the corner of the brush

steps.subject: land
steps.action: brown dirt across the bottom
steps.motion: go across and let it break

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: bring bushes down into the dirt
steps.motion: pull bushes down into the dirt
steps.rule: otherwise the dirt just floats there

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: bushes with thinned ocher using the one inch brush

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: knife point sticks and twigs through the paint
steps.motion: cut through to show the black
steps.rule: makes it look like sticks

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: big tree with a limb in brown and burnt umber

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: tap a white highlight on the tree side
steps.rule: just enough to make it stand out

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: quick cadmium yellow indications of leaves
